rule.selection: source id above registration watermark AND source observed_ms/bar_ms at or after registration; no old entries or replacement admissions
rule.timing: as-of source opened_ms; decisions committed before reading outcomes; source may publish120s late and observer discovery>180s is UNKNOWN; observational labels not executable fills
rule.comparison: known ACCEPT+REJECT closed controls versus accepted identical closed controls; UNKNOWN controls kept separately
rule.costs: source unchanged: 2USDT cost-aware risk budget;4bp fees eachside;5bp adverse entry/exit slip;adverse1bp/8h funding; no portfolioROI claim

gate.name: range-oi-flow-confirmation-v1
gate.decision_time: unchanged source opened_ms; feature received_ms and exchange time must not exceed this as-of time
gate.oi: latest valid sample received by decision and latest received by decision-5min; each endpoint at most90s old; strict decline
gate.flow: last completed UTC minute; LONG buy_quote>sell_quote; SHORT sell_quote>buy_quote; equality rejects
gate.flow_quality: one same-session target segment, full contiguous ID span/messages, adjacent previous-last and successor-first IDs; all used observations received by decision
gate.connection_quality: same session starts before flow minute, covers minute and known successor; no recorded lifecycle, ID-gap or invalid-stream issue in five-minute context plus endpoint age allowance
gate.unknown: missing, malformed, stale, late-mutated or uncertified evidence is UNKNOWN, never a rejection or zero return
gate.costs: unchanged source entries, exits, quantity, risk and modeled costs; no replacement trades
gate.scope: as-of paired observational label; delayed source publication is not proof of executable timing
gate.future_safety: future rows cannot add feature information; a final target aggregate containing post-decision receipts is UNKNOWN because its past prefix cannot be reconstructed
gate.market_scope: observed Binance aggTrade stream only, not all exchange transactions or complete liquidation volumes

rule.promotion: none; descriptive first review after14 elapsed days and50known closed pairs, never automatic paper promotion

historical_classification: diagnostic only; observed before future cohort; no accepted closed outcomes
registration: actual server time and CURRENT source max-ID frozen atomically at initialization; must be >=168; no backfill
validation_fix: finite derived OI evidence only, no threshold changes; original gate archived and20/20 historical outputs identical
